argv:
pause_lock() {
  case "$1" in '/bin/mkdir "$LOCK"')
    trap - DEBUG
    touch "$PAUSED"
    for i in {1..500}; do [ -f "$RESUME" ] && break; /bin/sleep 0.01; done
    ;;
  esac
}
set -T
trap 'pause_lock "$BASH_COMMAND"' DEBUG
source "$1"

scope: direct Popen processes and their complete session groups; no detached/native open launches
